questions.question: On Sunday morning, Maria read m pages each hour for 3 hours, and Jin read p pages each hour for 6 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of pages read by Maria and Jin on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Maria read 3m pages and Jin read 6p, so the total is 3m + 6p.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Dana swam a laps each hour for 4 hours, and Luis swam b laps each hour for 5 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of laps swam by Dana and Luis on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Dana swam 4a laps and Luis swam 5b, so the total is 4a + 5b.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Priya sent e emails each hour for 6 hours, and Omar sent f emails each hour for 3 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of emails sent by Priya and Omar on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Priya sent 6e emails and Omar sent 3f, so the total is 6e + 3f.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Chen sorted c cards each hour for 2 hours, and Rosa sorted d cards each hour for 7 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of cards sorted by Chen and Rosa on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Chen sorted 2c cards and Rosa sorted 7d, so the total is 2c + 7d.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Ben biked x miles each hour for 5 hours, and Alicia biked y miles each hour for 4 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of miles biked by Ben and Alicia on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Ben biked 5x miles and Alicia biked 4y, so the total is 5x + 4y.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Tom packed s boxes each hour for 3 hours, and Keisha packed t boxes each hour for 8 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of boxes packed by Tom and Keisha on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Tom packed 3s boxes and Keisha packed 8t, so the total is 3s + 8t.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Ivy solved j problems each hour for 4 hours, and Marcus solved k problems each hour for 6 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of problems solved by Ivy and Marcus on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Ivy solved 4j problems and Marcus solved 6k, so the total is 4j + 6k.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Sam delivered u flyers each hour for 7 hours, and Nina delivered v flyers each hour for 2 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of flyers delivered by Sam and Nina on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Sam delivered 7u flyers and Nina delivered 2v, so the total is 7u + 2v.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Leo practiced g songs each hour for 5 hours, and Hana practiced h songs each hour for 3 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of songs practiced by Leo and Hana on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Leo practiced 5g songs and Hana practiced 3h, so the total is 5g + 3h.

questions.question: On Sunday morning, Ava edited q photos each hour for 8 hours, and Raj edited r photos each hour for 5 hours. Which of the following represents the total number of photos edited by Ava and Raj on Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: Ava edited 8q photos and Raj edited 5r, so the total is 8q + 5r.
